text.en:
In due recognition to the outstanding contributions of the late Quezon City Mayor Norberto S.
Amoranto in the improvement of barangays and the development of Quezon City into a modern metropolis,
Barangay Gintong Silahis in the first district of Quezon City is hereby renamed Barangay N. S. Amoranto.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 7, 1984
